column1: # Why it is wired this way (moved from bin/context-injection-install.sh, harbor#1272):
# THE TOOL EVENTS CARRY A DERIVED MATCHER (@derived): the union of the `tool:` values of every pack the engine may meet,
# which inject-install computes and passes. PreToolUse and PostToolUse fire on every tool call, so the matcher keeps the
# engine from forking on tools no rule can match; PostToolUseFailure fires only when something failed, the cheapest
# moment for a repair. A matcher written here would go stale the moment a pack changes (harbor#184).
# NO UserPromptSubmit, deliberately: it fires on every prompt, ambient injection with a per-turn multiplier.
# PreCompact stays wired though nothing ships on it: packs are data, so a `mode: notify` rule at compaction time must not
# need the installer re-run to exist.
